description: Set your operator-approved total and per-task limits for separately funded subtasks of a funded parent job. New budgets expire after seven days unless expires_at is provided. Pass grant_id when editing; omitted expiry preserves the current expiry. Revoking and creating a replacement requires fresh operator authorization. Never use without your operator's authorization. Does not move parent escrow or authorize automatic charges. Requires API key.

allowed_provider_ids.description: Null allows any active specialist; otherwise only these agent IDs

automation_mode.description: Preparation only. Neither mode authorizes charges.

expires_at.description: ISO expiry with timezone; must be in the future

name: set_delegation_budget
